messages:
Aisha: Heads up — CardioCare's procurement just returned our vendor risk form with two hard blockers: they need a SOC2 artefact (they asked for Type II letter) and clarification on embeddings handling for healthcare data (PHI). They warned they will pause renewal invoicing if we don't respond by Wednesday EOD.

Tom: Copy. Can someone grab the redacted SOC2 letter and subprocessors export? I'll draft the short FAQ on embeddings and deletion APIs.

Leo: I can pull the subprocessors CSV and the SOC2 letter. Note: full SOC2 report requires an NDA; we provide a redacted letter publicly. Also we have a standard DPA template.

Aisha: Procurement specifically asked: "do embeddings store tenant IDs or PII? what's the retention policy? can we request deletion and audit the deletion action?"

Tom: Short answers to include in outbound: 1) We do not store raw PII inside vectors. 2) Metadata may include tenant_id by default but we can strip tenant identifiers on request. 3) Default retention for ephemeral embedding indexes is 30 days; persistent storage only with contract. 4) Deletion: we support per-tenant deletion APIs and provide deletion audit logs. I'll add example commands.

Priya: AM flagged renewal risk in Salesforce. Can we also include recommended deployment options for PHI customers? They asked whether hosted is acceptable or if private is required.

Leo: For PHI we recommend Private or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS / BYOK. Hosted can be used if customer performs pseudonymization client-side or accepts our opt-in transform (requires review).

LegalBot: DPA template available. Redlines require review; typical turnaround 2 business days. NDA link: https://redwood.secure/nda. SOC2 redacted letter can be shared immediately; full report after signed NDA.

Tom: Drafting outbound now. I'll attach: redacted SOC2 letter, subprocessors.csv, DPA template, and a one-page embeddings FAQ with code samples and deletion API snippet. Will ask them to sign NDA for full report.

Aisha: Please cc the AM and add a renewal-risk note that procurement may withhold payment. Also request their timeline and whether they require encryption-at-rest pseudonymization for hosted.

Tom: OUTBOUND (paste): "Hi — attached: redacted SOC2 Type II letter (PDF), subprocessors.csv, and our standard DPA template. To view the full SOC2 report we require a signed NDA via https://redwood.secure/nda; please sign and we'll provision access. Embeddings FAQ: default retention 30 days for ephemeral indexes; persistent storage only by agreement. We do not embed raw PII into vectors; metadata may include tenant identifiers but these can be redacted/stripped. Deletion API is available; see example below. Happy to schedule a 30m technical call — proposed attendees: Security (Leo), Solutions Eng (Tom), AM (Priya)."

Tom: Deletion API snippet to include: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/$TENANT_ID/embeddings/delete -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"`

Priya: Thanks — AM wants them looped in and wants a calendar hold for follow-up. I've added the hold for Thursday morning.

Leo: Once NDA is signed I'll upload the scoped controls summary and auditor letter to the secure vault.

Onboarding Bot: Status -> vendor-form: received; evidence-package: drafting (owner: Tom); NDA: pending; DPA: sent (template attached); renewal-risk: elevated.

Aisha: Good. Tom, post the outbound copy here after you send it and I'll close the loop with the AM.

Tom: Sent and posted. Will monitor replies and escalate to Legal if we get DPA redlines. :thumbsup:
